title: Lagos / Street kiosk
creator: Nia Forms
context: Original street-kiosk composition for an urban Lagos setting. No real shop or operator is represented.
desc: A kiosk with a corrugated shell, service counter, fabric awning and produce crates.

title: Djembe / Goblet drum
creator: Dayo Objects
context: Original goblet-drum interpretation. Not a measured replica of a museum instrument.
desc: A turned wooden body, membrane, rope rings and individually modelled tension cords.

title: Calabash / Bowl set
creator: Nia Forms
context: Original unengraved gourd-form bowls. No historic ornament or ceremonial function is reproduced.
desc: Three open bowl forms with inner surfaces and different sizes, arranged as a prop set.

title: Coastal / Timber doorway
creator: Nia Forms
context: Original doorway study informed by Swahili coastal architecture. Not a copy of a named historic door.
desc: A double timber doorway with recessed panels, brass fittings, a lintel and plaster surround.

title: Kente / Strip-weave study
creator: Sefi Materials
context: New procedural stripe composition informed by kente strip-weaving. Not an authenticated traditional pattern.
desc: A procedural strip-weave colour study on a draped mesh with fine fibre relief.

title: Raffia / Woven surface
creator: Sefi Materials
context: Original natural-fibre surface study. The regional setting is a design reference, not verified cultural provenance.
desc: A woven surface with bound edges, restrained natural colours and procedural fibre relief.

title: Baobab / Dry-season tree
creator: Nia Forms
context: Stylised Adansonia digitata study. The species also occurs beyond Africa; this is not a botanical scan.
desc: A broad trunk and branching dry-season silhouette with procedural bark relief. No foliage included.

title: Jiko / Charcoal stove
creator: Dayo Objects
context: Original digital stove study referencing the jiko form used in Kenya. Not a functional stove or safety specification.
desc: A metal shell, lined chamber, grate, air door, pot rests and wire carrying handle.

title: Market / Timber handcart
creator: Dayo Objects
context: Original market-cart prop for a contemporary East African scene. Not a documented regional artefact.
desc: A timber cargo bed, individual boards, corner fittings, two wheels and towing arms.

title: Earthenware / Storage jar
creator: Nia Forms
context: Original wheel-thrown vessel study for a West African domestic setting. No named pottery tradition is claimed.
desc: An earthenware vessel with an open inner wall, wheel-thrown surface lines and a separate lid.
